design.name: Efficient Frontier FC
design.question: Which football squad delivers the most modeled value under a weekly wage budget?
design.classification: StatsBomb-derived VAEP ratings with EA FC 24 wage proxies
design.north: Let a football analyst inspect a feasible squad and its out-of-sample evidence at each available wage budget.
design.layout: Budget ribbon; frontier on the left and actual XI on a green tactical pitch; squad register and backtest below.
limits: EA FC 24 wages are video-game proxies, not verified player contracts; older-season cost comparisons are especially limited.
The frontier uses precomputed feasible grid points and the existing 23-player quotas; no interpolated squad is invented.
The pitch groups the selected XI by position, without inventing tactical chemistry or scouting judgments.
Value per euro beats the optimizer at both reported backtest budgets. Oracle has second-half hindsight and is not a guaranteed realized ceiling.

source: Committed repository data and reviewed dashboard arrays
